query: Best street food spots and street food markets in Hanoi

places.title: Phố ẩm thực Tống Duy Tân
places.text: Located in the Hoan Kiem district, this is Hanoi's most famous 24/7 food street. It is packed with local stalls and restaurants serving classics like cháo cá (fish porridge), hotpot, and fried rice. It's a prime spot for late-night dining and soaking in the lively street atmosphere.
places.address: 2RHV+FHW, Cấm Chỉ, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Dong Xuan Alley (Ngõ Đồng Xuân)
places.text: A narrow lane adjacent to the historic Dong Xuan Market, this alley is a concentrated hub for traditional Northern Vietnamese street food. It is best known for bún chả, snails, and various types of sweet dessert soups (chè). It offers an authentic, busy local market dining experience.
places.opening_hours: Open daily (typically daytime until early evening)
places.address: Ng. Đồng Xuân, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Hanoi Weekend Night Market
places.text: Stretching from Hang Dao Street to the edge of Dong Xuan Market, this bustling market operates on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday nights. While it sells various goods, the street food section is a major draw, offering grilled skewers, tteokbokki, fruit shakes, and traditional snacks.
places.address: 104 P. Hàng Đào, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội, Vietnam

places.title: Banh Mi 25
places.text: Perhaps the most iconic Banh Mi spot in Hanoi's Old Quarter, this stall has grown into a highly popular street food destination. Known for its crispy baguettes and fresh fillings, it offers a variety of options including pork, chicken, and vegetarian choices with a simple outdoor seating area.
places.address: 25 P. Hàng Cá, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội 100000, Vietnam

places.title: KIN Streetfood
places.text: A top-rated local food spot in the heart of the Old Quarter specializing in late-night street food. It provides a more intimate street-side experience for those looking to explore authentic flavors after most day markets have closed.
places.address: 84 P.Thuốc Bắc, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội 10000, Vietnam
